info.title: Attendance Intelligence API
info.description: Multi-tenant attendance intelligence: ingest attendance evidence, ask grounded questions with citations and confidence, export results, and improve answers through reviewer feedback. Every endpoint except health and the demo sign-in needs a bearer token (POST /api/v1/auth/dev-token in development). See README.md for examples.
